preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of roads is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i < i for i, p_i in enumerate(roads, start=2))
preconditions.description: Each road connects city p_i to city i where 1 <= p_i < i.
The number of bus routes m is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in bus_routes)
preconditions.description: Each bus route connects two distinct cities a and b where 1 <= a, b <= n.
The number of questions q is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in questions)
preconditions.description: Each question asks about two distinct cities v and u where 1 <= v, u <= n.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of questions q.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (isinstance(output[i], int) and output[i] >= 1) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each output is either -1 or a positive integer representing the minimum number of buses needed.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 if not is_connected_by_bus(questions[i][0], questions[i][1]) else True for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: If it is not possible to get from city v to city u by bus, the output is -1.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == min_buses_needed(questions[i][0], questions[i][1]) if output[i] != -1 else True for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: If it is possible to get from city v to city u by bus, the output is the minimum number of buses needed.
